annotations.title: What a company's ads ask for and pay by role

description: What one employer's job ads say, as shown on its JobCrawls company page: the skills, benefits, perks, required languages, education levels and job types its ads name, each as a share of the ads read; the share of ads that do not require Finnish; the employer's advertised monthly pay by role (median low and high ends, ads stating pay) next to what the role pays in Finland; and the pay headline from salary reports JobCrawls users shared, only when enough reports exist. Takes a companyId from search_jobs, get_job_details or find_employers. Employers without enough ads return no profile. Reuse: figures may be quoted with a visible link to the jobcrawls.com page in the result (or "JobCrawls (jobcrawls.com)" where a link is impossible); each result repeats this in dataUse.

companyId.description: The companyId from a search result, a job listing or find_employers.

locale.description: Language of the result and of the linked jobcrawls.com pages. Defaults to English.

name: get_company_ad_profile

basis.description: Where the figures come from: source, as-of date and sample.

dataUse.description: What may be reused from this result and how to credit JobCrawls.
